verdict.rationale: The Speech-to-Text API documents a `webhook` flag that processes a request asynchronously and sends the results to configured webhooks. That is a real first-party outbound HTTP callback, but the evidence covers only transcription-completion delivery. It does not show how webhooks are registered, which event types exist, or how payloads are verified. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration/configuration flow, a broader event catalog, payload schema and signature verification docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: If webhook is set to true, the request will be processed asynchronously and results sent to configured webhooks.
